name: Halloween
description: Halloween and October theme nights: midnight purple, pumpkin orange, slime-green glow, moonlit skies, cobwebs, fog and dripping type. Tombstone player cards, glowing jack-o'-lanterns and a spooky home-run stinger. Every graphic type, plus basketball, football and hockey.
